name: PowMap live room scan (VGGT-SLAM 2.0, powmap.pow/scan)
purpose: PowMap's room scan: the phone page streams JPEG frames over WebSocket /scan/ws on :8765 (https://powmap.pow/scan/* via Traefik on .100); VGGT-SLAM 2.0 (VGGT-1B + SALAD loop closure, SL(4) pose graph) builds the point cloud live (PLY snapshot per submap) and an Open3D TSDF mesh + cameras.json at the end, which the projector solver ray-casts; every frame is kept for an offline pass. Code: the PowMap repo's scanner/
installedBy: hosts/gpu-195/install.sh (rootless podman quadlet, user powos, linger on; image built from ~/powmap-scanner = PowMap scanner/)
autosleep: own idle policy: the GPU engine process starts on a scan and exits 300 s after the last one (all VRAM back, CUDA context included); the HTTP server stays up (~200 MB RAM, no VRAM)
vramMeasured: 7.3 GiB peak during a scan (TUM fr1/room, 146 keyframes, 10 submaps); 2.7 GiB loaded and idle; 0 after the idle release
vramNote: GPU1 only, shared with stt-batch (resident 2.4 GiB) and llm-pool: a scan asks llama-swap to unload (POST /api/models/unload) and waits for 10000 MB free; the pool loads again on its next request once the engine has exited. Never GPU0 (docs/GPU-SERVERS-PLAN.md); the worker also checks GPU1's UUID before loading
